source: Curated role taxonomy — author + cross-referenced with O*NET, BLS SOC, LinkedIn Skills Graph

roles.name: Staff Engineer / Tech Lead
roles.definition: Senior IC who owns architecture, cross-team trade-offs, and mentorship without a direct-report headcount. The ladder above Senior; sits next to Engineering Manager.

roles.name: Engineering Manager
roles.definition: First-line or second-line people manager for an engineering team; owns hiring, allocation, performance, and team-level delivery.

roles.name: Security Engineer
roles.definition: Generalist security IC: detection, IR, vulnerability management, threat modeling. Bridges multiple subdomains.

roles.name: Application Security Engineer
roles.definition: Embedded with engineering teams to secure code, libraries, APIs, and third-party integrations. Owns SDLC security.

roles.name: Cloud Security Engineer
roles.definition: Owns cloud-native security: IAM, network policy, CSPM, workload identity, secrets management. Often paired with platform engineering.

roles.name: Offensive Security / Red Team
roles.definition: Adversarial testers — penetration testing, red-team operations, exploit development. Often consultancy-based.

roles.name: AI Research Engineer
roles.definition: Frontier-lab role: pretraining, alignment, evaluation, novel architecture work. PhD-equivalent ramp.

roles.name: ML Engineer
roles.definition: Builds production ML systems: training pipelines, feature engineering, model serving, evaluation.

roles.name: MLOps Engineer
roles.definition: Reliability and infrastructure for ML in production: training infra, feature stores, eval pipelines, model monitoring.

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.definition: Builds and operates data pipelines, warehouses, lakehouses, and the foundations every analytics + ML system depends on.

roles.name: AI Application Engineer
roles.definition: Integrates LLMs and other foundation models into product surfaces. Builds RAG pipelines, agents, evaluations, prompt templates.

roles.name: Data Scientist
roles.definition: Statistical modeling, experimentation, exploratory analysis. Increasingly bifurcated into causal/experimentation specialists vs. notebook generalists.

roles.name: Analytics Engineer
roles.definition: Owns the semantic / modeling layer between raw data and analyst consumers. dbt-native role.

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.definition: Operational analytics: dashboards, ad-hoc queries, business-facing analysis.

roles.name: Platform Engineer
roles.definition: Builds the internal developer platform: golden paths, IDPs, infrastructure abstractions, self-service tooling.

roles.name: Site Reliability Engineer
roles.definition: Production reliability: SLOs, on-call, capacity, observability, incident response.

roles.name: DevOps Engineer
roles.definition: CI/CD, deployment automation, IaC. Title is in slow decline as work bifurcates into platform vs SRE.

roles.name: Cloud Engineer
roles.definition: Cloud-platform-specific engineering: AWS/Azure/GCP architecture, FinOps, multi-cloud cost engineering.

roles.name: Systems / Low-level Engineer
roles.definition: Kernel, compiler, distributed-systems internals, ML systems (CUDA/vLLM/SGLang), database engines.

roles.name: Embedded Engineer
roles.definition: Software for hardware: IoT, automotive, robotics, defense, edge AI. C/C++ + RTOS focus.

roles.name: Backend Engineer
roles.definition: Server-side application code: APIs, services, databases, business logic.

roles.name: Frontend Engineer
roles.definition: Browser-side application code: components, state, routing, performance, accessibility.

roles.name: Full-Stack Engineer
roles.definition: Spans frontend + backend + sometimes infra. Most generalist engineering shape.

roles.name: iOS Engineer
roles.definition: Native iOS apps in Swift/Objective-C, SwiftUI, UIKit.

roles.name: Android Engineer
roles.definition: Native Android apps in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK.

roles.name: SDET / Test Infrastructure
roles.definition: Builds test frameworks, CI test infra, production-like test environments. Increasingly converges with backend / platform engineering.

roles.name: QA Automation
roles.definition: Writes automated tests: Selenium, Cypress, Playwright. Compressing fastest of any engineering-adjacent role.

roles.name: QA Manual
roles.definition: Hand-driven test execution against test plans. The textbook AI-replacement case in this analysis.

roles.name: Technical Product Manager
roles.definition: PM for technically-deep products: dev tools, AI features, infrastructure, platforms.

roles.name: Product Manager
roles.definition: Owns what gets built: discovery, prioritization, requirements, roadmap.

roles.name: UX Designer / Researcher
roles.definition: Bundle of two roles: UX design (IA, wireframes) and UX research (study design, synthesis). Splitting into separate tracks.

roles.name: Product Designer
roles.definition: End-to-end product design: visual + interaction + systems thinking. Increasingly converges with senior frontend at AI-native cos.

roles.name: UI Designer
roles.definition: Visual interface design: layout, typography, color, component visuals.

roles.name: Solutions Architect
roles.definition: Customer-facing technical role at vendors and consultancies. Owns the deal-side technical narrative.

roles.name: Developer Experience Engineer
roles.definition: Builds the SDK, CLI, docs, internal platform, and onboarding for developer-facing products.

roles.name: Prompt Engineer
roles.definition: Standalone title focused on prompt design and tuning. Largely a 2023 artifact; absorbed into AI Application / ML Eng work in 2025-26.
